title: Students march toward Westfield Monument during teachers’ strike
location: The Voice Gambia reports students set out from various unspecified schools toward Westfield Monument; arrival is unconfirmed.
organizer: Students from unspecified schools; formal organizer not reported.
participants_original: The report describes ‘scores’ of students but gives no numerical estimate or site-level count.
threshold_50_evidence: One report describes ‘scores’ of students but provides no number or simultaneous count at a public site. The evidence does not establish 50 or more at any one site; eligibility remains pending threshold review.

start_date.summary: The Voice Gambia article is dated January 10 and says the march began ‘on Monday’; it does not state an absolute event date. The calendar date remains pending corroboration and January 9 is not coded as established.

location.summary: The report says students set out from various schools toward Westfield Monument; the schools, route, arrival and exact site count are not stated.

organizer.summary: Participants are described as students from various schools; no formal organizing body is identified.

demands.summary: The report describes calls for government and teachers to settle the dispute and teachers to return, with student concerns about examinations and incomplete lessons.

participants_original.summary: The report uses the qualitative term ‘scores’ and supplies no numeric count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No source establishes 50 or more simultaneous attendees at any one site.

end_date.summary: The article does not say whether students reached the monument or when the physical march ended.

protester_violence.summary: The visible article section does not describe protester violence; silence remains unknown.

state_response.summary: The article does not report an actual response by authorities to this march; all response dimensions remain unknown.

state_target.summary: Students are reported to have called on government and teachers to settle the dispute; the relative weight of the state-directed request is not otherwise documented.

notes: A single local report documents a physical march beginning from unspecified schools toward a named public destination. The report is dated January 10 and says the march began ‘on Monday,’ but the exact calendar date remains pending corroboration and is left unknown. Its unquantified ‘scores’ does not establish the 50-person threshold; no site-level headcount, arrival/end or independent confirmation is reported. The joint call to government and teachers leaves the state-directed policy target unresolved. This remains a provisional candidate, not an inclusion or official update.
open_questions: Can another source or organizer record establish whether at least 50 students were simultaneously present at one public site?
Did participants reach Westfield Monument, and what were the actual route and physical end time?
Which schools participated, and do any reported group totals refer to simultaneous attendees at one site?
What calendar date did the physical march begin? The article’s relative “Monday” reference is not coded as an absolute date.
How should the joint request to government and teachers be represented in the demand classification?
Is the report independent, syndicated, or derived from another written origin?
